metadata.question: Does the floodplain along Cooper Creek, downstream of Windorah, 10 km radius around (-27.667421, 141.780304), show higher vegetation greenness on April 22, 2025 than on April 6, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) over a 10 km radius buffer around point (-27.667421, 141.780304). Two windows around target dates: 2025-04-06 (±2 days) and 2025-04-22 (±2 days). If empty, widen to ±6 days; if still empty, fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2 SR (LC08/LC09) with same widened window.
2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask QA60 clouds/cirrus and SCL cloud/shadow classes; scale reflectance to [0–1], compute NDVI. For Landsat L2, mask clouds/shadows via QA_PIXEL, scale reflectance using scale/offset, compute NDVI.
3. Logic: Check collection sizes (C1), then valid pixel counts via Reducer.count (C2). Compute mean NDVI and ensure it’s numeric and within [-1, 1] (C3). Compare mean NDVI of Apr 22 vs Apr 6 for final A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([141.780304, -27.667421]).buffer(10000);
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    // Utilities
    function s2MaskScale(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const cloudFree = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const sclMask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10));
      const scaled = img.select(['B4','B8']).multiply(0.0001);
      return scaled.updateMask(cloudFree).updateMask(sclMask)
        .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function s2NDVICol(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end)
        .map(s2MaskScale)
        .map(function(img){ return img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('ndvi')
          .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); });
    }
    function lsMaskScale(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).eq(0) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5).eq(0));     // snow
      const scaled = img.select(['SR_B4','SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return scaled.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function lsNDVICol(start, end) {
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      return l9.merge(l8)
        .map(lsMaskScale)
        .map(function(img){ return img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('ndvi')
          .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); });
    }
    async function analyzeWindow(label, centerDateStr) {
      const center = ee.Date(centerDateStr);
      const start1 = center.advance(-2, 'day');
      const end1 = center.advance(2, 'day');
      const start2 = center.advance(-6, 'day');
      const end2 = center.advance(6, 'day');

      // Try S2 ±2d
      let col = s2NDVICol(start1, end1);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      let source = 'S2±2d', usedStart = start1, usedEnd = end1;
      if (size === 0) { // widen S2 ±6d
        col = s2NDVICol(start2, end2);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        source = 'S2±6d'; usedStart = start2; usedEnd = end2;
      }
      if (size === 0) { // fallback Landsat ±6d
        col = lsNDVICol(start2, end2);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        source = 'LS±6d'; usedStart = start2; usedEnd = end2;
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', label };
      }

      const ndvi = col.median().select('ndvi');
      const total = await ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('one').getInfo();
      const valid = await ndvi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('ndvi').getInfo();
      if (!total || total === 0 || !valid || valid === 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', label, source, imgs: size, total: total || 0, valid: valid || 0 };
      }
      const mean = await ndvi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('ndvi').getInfo();

      if (mean === null || Number.isNaN(mean) || mean < -1 || mean > 1) {
        return { status: 'C3', label, source, imgs: size, total, valid, mean };
      }
      const startStr = await ee.Date(usedStart).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
      const endStr = await ee.Date(usedEnd).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
      const cloudPct = (1 - valid / total) * 100.0;
      console.log(`${label} source:${source} imgs:${size} window:${startStr}..${endStr}`);
      console.log(`${label} valid:${valid}/${total} cloud:${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}% meanNDVI:${mean.toFixed(3)}`);
      return { status: 'OK', label, source, imgs: size, total, valid, mean };
    }

    // 2. Run two analyses
    const r1 = await analyzeWindow('Apr06', '2025-04-06');
    if (r1.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`${r1.label} status:${r1.status}`); console.log(r1.status); return; }
    const r2 = await analyzeWindow('Apr22', '2025-04-22');
    if (r2.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`${r2.label} status:${r2.status}`); console.log(r2.status); return; }

    // 3. Final decision
    const delta = r2.mean - r1.mean;
    console.log(`Delta NDVI (Apr22-Apr06): ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(delta > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
